# PR 1 Body: LangChain Integration Foundation

- Adds LangChain-focused Burgess governance integration guidance.
- Updates integrations index documentation for discoverability.

## Why this matters

This establishes a concrete, high-signal entry point for maintainers who want to add named human-review checkpoints before decisions affect identified individuals.

## Validation

- Documentation-only change
- No runtime code paths modified
- No doctrinal wording changes in canonical doctrine files

## Risk and mitigation

- Scope risk mitigated by limiting PR 1 to two integration docs files
- Overclaim risk mitigated by positioning as implementation guidance, not legal determination
